title: How to get around MV's 26000px picture limit

posts.author: unnamedregister
posts.body: I've been making a scene that requires an image 26112x624, however when I import it the screen goes black.

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Um.
So MV doesn't have a pixel limit,
per se
- as 32-bit software it has a limit on accessible memory. Trying to load an image that size requires more RAM than it can use (and more than some of your players might have).
The only reason I can think of for an image that size is some huge parallax map, so I assume that's what it's for. You'll have to break it up into multiple maps.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
Make the image loopable at a length of 1 or maybe 2 screens in length.
If you read Galv's help doc on the plugin you can use variable values as inputs.
So set a default speed on map load, have a parallel monitoring player input. Player input increases the variable.
26k pixels is insane. Maybe at some point you should ask yourself "there has to be a better way of executing this idea without requiring an image that is 90 centimeters short of a kilometer in length at standard dpi"
